name: gpux macOS fast-mode perf and memory, part 2
objective: Continue reducing CPU and memory on native macOS, both fast modes: skip the owner view's render and the content layout on scroll-only frames (scroll-div-cards under 2 ms), cheaper reuse of retained views (dashboard-clock draw under 1 ms), scroll footprint at most 1.3x off, no regressions elsewhere.

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.
